title: Lior and the Signal
author: Quentin Underhill
blurb: Vesper Oyelaran, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
